messages:
anya (PM): quick post-launch check-in — we shipped v1.3 yesterday. I want to align on next 6-week cadence: small stability patch in 2w, then a follow-on milestoned feature slice (customer-driven) in 6w. need decisions on bug vs enhancement prioritization and a lightly opinionated rollout plan.

devon (eng): +1. can you share the top 10 customer-reported items? that’ll help triage cost.

anya (PM): attaching the short list below (excerpted from support triage):
- customer A: streaming truncated on long responses (high freq)
- customer B: embedding mismatch vs docs (low freq, confusing)
- internal: occasional OOM on dedupe reranker (non-prod)
- multi-tenant: rate-limit spikes under burst (seen twice)

qian (product design): for UX-impacting bugs (stream truncated, embedding mismatch) we should aim for fix in the 2w patch if low engineering effort. otherwise schedule in the 6w milestone with canary.

maria (CS): FYI customer A is on a Dedicated plan and flagged as high-risk churn if not resolved quickly. they gave a repro flow. I can drop the repro steps into the bug ticket.

devon (eng): repro steps please — also need SLO for rollback. my quick read: streaming truncation looks like a KV cache edge case; might be a small hotfix (1-2 dev days). OOM needs investigation and longer lead.

anya (PM): decision proposal:
1) Patch (2w) — priority = (severity >= high OR paying-customer churning) OR low-effort fix (<3 dev days). includes streaming truncation, rate-limit config tweak, and hotfix instrumentation for OOM.
2) Milestone (6w) — larger items & enhancements: embedding quality improvements, dedupe reranker perf, rolling canary release for rate-limit behavior.
3) Acceptance criteria for patch: automated regression test + e2e repro for the paying customer + canary deploy to Dedicated for one day.

sam (EM): I like the gating. add: require perf smoke tests (p99 latency) before canary is promoted. also mark any change touching KV cache as a restricted rollout (dev + infra review).

devon (eng): agreed. for the patch can we do a 'fast-forward' canary: Dedicated -> Dedicated-staging -> prod-city? ops-bot can we automate that?

ops-bot: Deploy pipeline supports staged canaries. Recommended action: use job "staged-canary-v2" with param: {"stages": 3, "smoke": true}. See https://deploy.corp/staged-canary for docs.

qian (product design): for the 6w milestone, let's include a small UX experiment for embedding mismatch: show source provenance and a confidence hint. that reduces CS load and might be shipped as an enhancement rather than a risky core model change.

maria (CS): that UX bandwidth would help support. if we schedule it for milestone week 4 we can start closed beta with Customer B.

anya (PM): excellent. next steps:
- devon: open/label the 4 tickets I listed, estimate effort, and mark high-risk paying customers.
- sam: block two engineers for week-of patch and one for canary automation.
- qian: draft the UX copy for provenance & confidence and sync with maria for beta.
- maria: collect repro & SLA notes for Customer A and B and add to tickets.
- ops-bot: add canary job link to the patch PR template.

devon (eng): will do. ETA for estimates: EOD tomorrow.

sam (EM): I'll confirm resource allocation after the engineering triage.

maria (CS): repro notes heading to the ticket now. tagging customer success engineer @lucy to coordinate.

qian (product design): i'll put a quick mock into Figma and share a link later today.

anya (PM): thanks. one more governance note — new rule for this post-launch wave: any change that reduces token performance by >5% or increases p99 by >10% needs escalation to performance council and an alternative rollback plan documented in the PR.

devon (eng): ack. can we add a simple checklist to PR template?

ops-bot: PR template updated: checklist items added — perf-impact, canary-stages, rollback-note. Template path: https://git.corp/redwood/repo/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.md

anya (PM): perfect. if nobody objects i'll mark the patch as "sprint:hotfix" and the milestone as "sprint:postlaunch-wave-1" by EOD. any objections?

sam (EM): no objections. sounds good.

maria (CS): +1 from support.

qian (product design): +1.

devon (eng): +1, will add estimates.

anya (PM): great — closing this thread. i'll post the triage doc and ticket links once devon updates estimates. :shipit:
